title: Internal CA trust bundle
description: Distributes the platform's internal CA certificate (cert-manager-issuers' krateo-root-ca-key-pair, key ca.crt) as a trust-manager Bundle: a ConfigMap holding only the public certificate, in each listed namespace. Requires trust-manager, whose trust namespace must be cert-manager-issuers' internalCA.namespace.

name.title: Bundle name
name.description: The Bundle's name, and the name of the ConfigMap written in each target namespace.

key.title: ConfigMap key
key.description: The key the CA certificate is written under.

namespaces.title: Namespaces
namespaces.description: The namespaces to write the ConfigMap in. Required when rendered: an empty list fails the render, because a Bundle without a namespace selector writes to every namespace.
